columns.validationmsg: 'Pur. Price should be greater than zero'
columns.name: purprice

table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	item.customicode, 
	itemname= item.name, 
	currlistrow = 0,
	stock     = 0.0000, 
	totalstock= 0.0000, 
	assgcode  = 1, 
	purquotationdetail.purquotationcode,   
	purquotationdetail.icode,   
	purquotationdetail.IDENTITYCOL,
	purquotationdetail.itemdescription,
	purquotationdetail.gcode,
	purquotationdetail.packunits,
	purquotationdetail.saleprice,
	purquotationdetail.purprice,
	unitsalestax=purquotationdetail.unitsalestax,
	GSTPerc=purquotationdetail.GSTPErc,
	purquotationdetail.bonusqty,
	purquotationdetail.discperc,
	purquotationdetail.qty
	
FROM 
	purquotationdetail,   
	item 
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.purquotationdetail.purquotationcode = :ai_Code ) AND
	( purquotationdetail.icode = item.icode )
ORDER BY
	rowid

objects.name: c_discperc
objects.expression: sum( qty * purprice * discperc * .01 for all)

objects.name: c_sumgstval
objects.expression: Sum ( Round(( c_itemtotal * gstperc * 0.01),2)  for all )
